name: Benin plaque with Oba, attendants, Portuguese figure, leopard and snake
note: This is a black-and-white photograph of a rectangular relief plaque with a central Oba figure, a Portuguese figure at left, an umbrella, a leopard and a snake. It looks like a Benin cast brass plaque of the 16th–17th century, but I couldn't match it to a specific museum object, so the attribution is a best guess.
